audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Lillia rows 0 and 6 and Skill everywhere else while Volibear wins 52.56% over 645 games — the packet flags the contradiction. The mirror (lillia__volibear) flipped rows 0, 1, 4, 5 and 6 to Volibear as one group and left rows 2 and 3 as Skill.
audit.why: Lillia's only real hold-off tool in lane is Swirlseed on a flat 12s; between those she has no escape from a run-down, and her ultimate needs her passive burn already applied.
audit.corrected: Volibear, Volibear, Skill, Skill, Volibear, Volibear, Volibear on both layers, with ratings and every why-string realigned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Lillia's spike ('sleeps you for a burst you can't answer') and first item as hers.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1) only makes enemies drowsy if Dream Dust is already on them — it is a follow-up, not an opener. Volibear's Sundered Sky heal and Stormbringer's bonus health plus tower disable land in the same window.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item now read as Volibear windows, with the burn precondition on her R stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real ability errors: Lillia's E was called 'Watch Out, Eep!' (that is her W) and was said to 'root' and to be a 'dash'. Riot's text: Swirlseed (E) is a thrown seed that damages and slows, rolling until it hits a wall or target; Watch Out! Eep! (W) is a ground zone with a heavy centre. Volibear's Sky Splitter was also treated as engage rather than a slow with a self-shield he only gets inside the blast.
audit.why: A player who thinks her E roots and dashes will never walk up; knowing it is a 12s slow on a rolling seed gives him the actual window to close.
audit.corrected: E is Swirlseed, a 12s / 700-range slow; W is Watch Out! Eep!, a zone with a heavy centre; Q's speed stacks come off spell hits; Frenzied Maul's second cast on the same mark heals the burn back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Wrong pronouns for a female champion in dontsFull[0].t, report[11].t and report[8].t ('his').
audit.why: Small, but it is the kind of error a paying reader notices immediately.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in place at identical length.

edits.before: Lillia kites you with Q Blooming Blows and E Watch Out, Eep! to keep her passive burn stacking while you can't close the gap; she out-pokes you every wave and you can't punish her without a gank.
edits.after: Lillia kites with Blooming Blows (Q) speed stacks and slows you with Swirlseed (E) — Watch Out! Eep! is her W, a ground zone, so step off its centre and keep walking her down.

edits.before: Her R Lilting Lullaby can drowse you for a long sleep and set up a burst, and even your R Stormbringer engage rarely lands because her Q movement speed and E dash create too much distance.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby (150s) only makes you drowsy if her passive burn is already on you, and Swirlseed is a rolling seed, not a dash — Stormbringer still closes the gap she has left.

edits.before: Level 1 is a skill check on positioning, but the moment Lillia has Q Blooming Blows she starts kiting you around the wave and stacking her passive burn faster than you can respond. You have no gap-closer until 6 and no ranged answer to her poke, so play safe, farm under tower, and call your jungler.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours: she has no way to hold you off yet, so walk her down and bank the health lead. Once Blooming Blows is up she stacks move speed off every spell hit, so deny the hits — stand off the centre of Watch Out! Eep!, and step in during the 12s after her Swirlseed.

edits.before: The mid-game is firmly Lillia's. Her E Watch Out, Eep! roots and her Q movement speed keep her permanently out of your Q range, and at 6 her R Lilting Lullaby can put you to sleep for a burst combo. Don't chase — you'll only eat more passive DoT. Farm what you safely can and look to roam or take plates elsewhere.
edits.after: The mid-game is even. Swirlseed (E) slows — it does not root — and it is her only way to hold you off, on a flat 12s. Walk up in that window, stun with Thundering Smash and bite the same mark twice for the heal. At 6 Lilting Lullaby only makes you drowsy if her passive burn is already ticking on you, so break off once you are burning.
